title: SimulCost: A Cost-Aware Benchmark and Toolkit for Automating Physics Simulations with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2603.20253v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Evaluating LLM agents for scientific tasks has focused on token costs while ignoring tool-use costs like simulation time and experimental resources. As a result, metrics like pass@k become impractical under realistic budget constraints. To address this gap, we introduce SimulCost, the first benchmark targeting cost-sensitive parameter tuning in physics simulations. SimulCost compares LLM tuning cost-sensitive parameters against traditional scanning approach in both accuracy and computational cost, spanning 2,643 single-round (initial guess) and 2,304 multi-round (adjustment by trial-and-error) tasks across 11 simulators from fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and plasma physics, whose costs are analytically defined and platform-independent. A twelfth simulator, a production plasma code measurable only by wall clock, is reported separately. Frontier LLMs achieve 45-62% success rates in single-round mode, dropping to 34-50% under h

translated_title: SimulCost：一个面向大语言模型自动化物理模拟的成本感知基准与工具包
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.20253v4 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：评估用于科学任务的LLM代理通常只关注令牌成本，而忽略了工具使用成本，如模拟时间和实验资源。因此，在现实预算约束下，诸如pass@k之类的指标变得不切实际。为解决这一差距，我们引入了SimulCost，这是首个针对物理模拟中成本敏感参数调优的基准。SimulCost将LLM调整成本敏感参数与传统扫描方法在准确性和计算成本上进行对比，涵盖来自流体动力学、固体力学和等离子体物理的11个模拟器中的2,643个单轮（初始猜测）和2,304个多轮（试错调整）任务，其成本被分析性定义且平台无关。第十二个模拟器是一个仅能通过墙钟时间测量的生产等离子体代码，被单独报告。前沿LLM在单轮模式中达到45-62%的成功率，在预算限制下降至34-50%。
tldr: 本文提出了SimulCost，这是首个关注物理模拟中成本敏感参数调优的基准，揭示了在现实预算约束下LLM的性能显著下降，并提供了跨11个模拟器的标准化评估平台。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SimulCost, the first benchmark targeting cost-sensitive parameter tuning in physics simulations, revealing that LLM performance drops significantly under realistic budget constraints and providing a standardized evaluation platform across 11 simulators.
